author: ribeye
dek: A Chillicothe family watched Ohio fall to Nevada, then watched Curaçao rout Nevada 11-2 to win the Little League World Series.
disclaimer: Parody: the Miller family of Chillicothe is fictional. The Little League World Series championship game is real, as reported by the Associated Press in August 2026.
headline: Ohio's Little League Dream Ends Saturday, Then Curaçao Steals the Show Sunday

ohio_story: CHILLICOTHE, Ohio — The Miller family had the whole Sunday planned around a baseball game in Pennsylvania they were watching from a couch in Chillicothe. Tom Miller, who coaches his son's Little League team at Yoctangee Park, had stocked the cooler, fired up the grill, and hung an Ohio flag on the porch after Hamilton, Ohio, made its run to Williamsport. Then Nevada beat Ohio on Saturday, and the flag came down before the burgers were even off the grill.

"We went from planning a parade route down Paint Street to rooting for a team from an island most of us couldn't find on a map," Tom said, flipping a burger with one hand and holding a scorecard with the other. "By the fifth inning I was standing up in my living room yelling for a kid named Juriënsly like I'd known him since tee-ball." His daughter, who had spent the week practicing her own pitching in the backyard, announced she was now a Curaçao fan for life and demanded a navy-and-yellow hat, which Tom promised to order just as soon as he finished explaining to her mother why the grill had caught fire twice.

The Millers watched the final out — a pop-up to center field — in near silence, then applauded anyway, because that is what you do when 12-year-olds play their hearts out on television. "Ohio lost on Saturday, and that stung," Tom said. "But those Curaçao kids went undefeated, and they celebrated like they'd won the whole world, which I suppose they did. We'll be back next year. Somebody from Ohio has to win this thing eventually, and it might as well be a kid from Ross County."
real_summary: Curaçao won its second Little League World Series title on Sunday, Aug. 30, 2026, beating Nevada 11-2 in the championship game at South Williamsport, Pennsylvania. Juriënsly De Windt and Shardijon De Lanoi each drove in three runs for the Pariba Little League team from Willemstad, which went unbeaten in the double-elimination tournament and won the island's first title since 2004.

Nevada, the United States champion from Henderson, jumped out to a 2-0 lead in the first inning on Maddox Bryan's two-run single, but Curaçao tied it on De Lanoi's two-run single, took the lead for good on Jaymiëll Martina's two-run double in the fourth, and broke it open when De Windt cleared the bases with a double in the fifth. De Windt started on the mound and allowed two runs, one earned, in three innings, and Giendry Ryan and Steven Felix were nearly flawless in relief, striking out four over the final three innings.

Nevada was the runner-up for the second straight year, having fallen to Taiwan in the 2025 championship game. Carsynn Meyer became the first girl to play for the United States in the championship game; she had gotten the first hit by a girl in the U.S. championship a day earlier, when Nevada beat Ohio on Saturday to win the U.S. title.
source_note: AP reporting, Aug. 30-31, 2026: Curaçao beats Nevada 11-2 in the Little League World Series championship game.
